title: Retrieve a matching fabric swatch from a sewing bin
instruction: Retrieve the teal cotton panel with white stripes from the gray bin. Grip the raised tape tab on the matching panel and lift it clear of the bin. Move other panels aside if needed. Place the entire target panel inside the green STAGING zone and let go. Leave every other panel in the bin. If you take a different panel out, put it back.
context: A home sewing project often calls for a matching fabric scrap. Find the striped fabric in a stack of overlapping scraps, lift it over the organizer wall, and move it to the work area while preserving the rest of the kit.
setup: Five 140 × 100 mm cotton, linen, and felt swatches in a 240 × 180 × 80 mm gray bin centered at (280, −120) mm. Place the 180 × 140 mm green staging zone at (280, 150) mm. Use seed 0. From bottom to top, set rust plaid linen, plain yellow linen, purple dotted felt, teal striped cotton, and teal cotton with large white rings at offsets (−43, −32), (43, 32), (−43, 32), (43, −32), (6, 3) mm from the bin center. Coordinates are measured in the tabletop plane with +x away from the arms and +y to robot-left. Use nominal 1-inch (25 mm) orange Pro Pocket Gaff cotton cloth tape. Cut a strip about 60 mm long and fold it over a 25 mm wide, 18 mm tall, 3.4 mm thick PETG stiffener. Bend the two adhesive ends outward at the bottom and press them onto the patterned face as mounting feet. The exposed grip is 25 mm wide, about 4 mm thick with two tape layers, and 18 mm tall. Keep the gripper faces free of exposed adhesive. Each swatch has one identical raised tab. For the five layers bottom to top, place the tab center at these offsets from its own swatch center, in mm: (−39, −24), (54, 16), (−44, 23), (54, −20), (2, 8).
scoring: Score = (0.3r + 0.7s)(1 − d). Measure the target fractions outside the bin r and in the staging zone s from above. d is the largest individual distractor fraction outside the bin. Use only the final state. Full completion requires the target released inside the staging zone and every distractor inside the bin.
run_limit: 4,800 control steps (240 simulated seconds at 20 Hz)
reset_notes: Restore the documented starting arrangement and wait for cloth to settle before each run.
fidelity: A rigid open bin holds five overlapping, initially flat deformable cloth layers. The stack approximates a mixed fabric bin. Fabric thickness ranges from 3.3 to 4.8 mm. Release is estimated from gripper clearance. The raised tape grip is modeled as a light rigid block shaped like the tape-wrapped stiffener attached to a small patch of the deformable mesh. The simulated tape neither peels nor flexes independently.
scores: Dream-1 scored 0.00 over 1,200 steps. The scripted expert scored 1.00 in 640 steps. Goal met.
